name: 76118 · Richland Hls, TX
findings: ZIP 76118 (Richland Hls) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76118 (Richland Hls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76118 (Richland Hls) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
